name: Contemporaneous records
statement: The actor creates and retains dated records of the decisions, data, analyses and communications that bear materially on an event threatening public security, for a defined period that outlasts foreseeable inquiry.
evidence_of_operation: A retention policy covering the relevant record types; records produced on inquiry that carry contemporaneous dates; version histories for public documents.

name: Production of original records
statement: The actor produces original records, not summaries, to bodies with a legitimate oversight or investigative remit within a stated period, or gives itemised reasons for any withholding.
evidence_of_operation: Records supplied in response to dated requests; a log of requests received and answered; itemised reasons for withholding (privacy, security, legal privilege) rather than blanket refusal.

name: Register of evidence requests
statement: The actor maintains a dated register of material evidence requests it has made or received, recording the recipient, the response and what remains outstanding, and publishes it where confidentiality permits.
evidence_of_operation: A published or producible register; entries that match requests cited in reports; dated updates.

name: Timely release of primary data
statement: The actor releases primary data material to understanding the event promptly, with metadata sufficient for independent analysis, and publicly explains any delay.
evidence_of_operation: Release dates close to collection dates; metadata and documentation adequate for re-analysis; dated explanations of any delay.

name: Access for independent verification
statement: The actor permits independent parties with a legitimate remit to verify material claims about its activities, through access to sites, systems, people or records, and states the legitimate limits on that access.
evidence_of_operation: Completed verification visits, audits or evaluations by independent parties; published terms of access; stated reasons where access was limited.

name: Access rights through the chain
statement: Where the actor funds, contracts or delegates work, it secures enforceable rights to the records of those it engages, monitors their use, and acts when access fails.
evidence_of_operation: Agreements containing record-access terms; monitoring records; documented escalation and sanctions when access was refused.

name: Mandatory reporting and follow-up
statement: The actor submits reports owed to funders, regulators or oversight bodies on time and escalates reportable events promptly; where the actor receives such reports, it follows up late, missing or anomalous reports without undue delay.
evidence_of_operation: Reports submitted by their due dates; documented escalation criteria; records of follow-up when reports were late or raised issues.

name: Disclosure of relevant interests
statement: The actor discloses financial, institutional, research and personal relationships relevant to the subject when it contributes to an assessment, publication or public statement, not only when challenged later.
evidence_of_operation: Disclosure statements published with the contribution; disclosures consistent with independently known relationships; no later material additions.

name: Review and management of declared interests
statement: The actor that convenes, publishes or relies on contributions reviews declared interests against information available to it, records how material conflicts were managed, and publishes contributors' roles.
evidence_of_operation: A published conflict policy; records of review and management decisions (recusal, disclosure, exclusion); published roles of assessment-body members.

name: Confidence proportionate to evidence
statement: The actor expresses confidence in public conclusions no more strongly than the evidence and access available support, and states material limitations with the same prominence as the conclusions.
evidence_of_operation: Summaries and press materials that carry the limitations stated in the full text; calibrated confidence language; conclusions attributed to those who reached them.

name: Missing evidence distinguished from contrary evidence
statement: The actor distinguishes evidence that is unavailable from evidence that weighs against a possibility, and explains how unavailable evidence affected its conclusions.
evidence_of_operation: Explicit statements of what could not be assessed and why; conclusions qualified accordingly.

name: Dissent recorded and disclosed
statement: The actor records material disagreement within its assessment bodies and leadership and discloses its substance and how it was resolved.
evidence_of_operation: Minority statements or recorded dissents in reports; leadership statements noting disagreement; an account of how disagreement was resolved.

name: Documented basis for headline judgments
statement: The actor documents how headline judgments (rankings, probability terms, risk levels) were selected and approved, including the evidence standard applied, and makes that account available.
evidence_of_operation: A published method for confidence language; approval records; an account linking the evidence base to the terms chosen.

name: Correction at the point of original publication
statement: When an earlier public statement of the actor is superseded, qualified or shown to be incomplete, the actor publishes a dated correction or contextual note linked from the original, without altering the historical record.
evidence_of_operation: Dated corrections, addenda or notes attached to or linked from the original; original text preserved.

name: Reasoned response to substantive criticism
statement: The actor publishes a reasoned response to specific, substantive criticism of its statements or processes within a stated period, whether it accepts, partly accepts or rebuts the criticism.
evidence_of_operation: Published responses that address the specific points raised; a stated process for handling formal criticism.

name: Independent audit and corrective action
statement: The actor submits its handling of material events to independent audit or review, states whether it accepts each finding and why, and reports implementation of corrective actions with dated evidence.
evidence_of_operation: A published audit with the actor's responses; recommendation-by-recommendation implementation reports; follow-up audits.

name: Currency of standing summaries
statement: The actor that maintains standing summaries (reference articles, guidance pages, fact sheets, risk assessments) updates them within a reasonable period when a later authoritative assessment supersedes their content, and dates historical positions.
evidence_of_operation: Revisions reflecting later assessments; dated statements of historical positions; a review cycle.

name: Response to outside review requests
statement: The actor acknowledges substantive, specific requests for review, information or audit cooperation from outside parties, including independent observers without a legal remit, and answers them within a period it states, by supplying the material, giving reasons for declining, or pointing to where the answer is already published.
evidence_of_operation: A published contact route and response period for enquiries and review requests; dated acknowledgments and answers; reasons given when a request is declined; a log of requests received and their outcome.

name: Provenance and integrity of released material
statement: The actor that releases documents identifies their source and custodian, how they were obtained, the release date and any redactions, and keeps a stable, versioned copy with integrity data such as hashes.
evidence_of_operation: Release notes stating source and custodian; stable URLs; version identifiers or hashes; redaction logs.

name: Accurate novelty and completeness claims
statement: The actor claims that released material is new, previously undisclosed or complete only where the claim is accurate, and specifies it item by item when a release mixes new and previously public material.
evidence_of_operation: Item-level statements of what is newly disclosed, newly unredacted or previously public; scope statements for collections.

name: Exhibits separated from interpretation
statement: The actor that publishes primary material alongside its own interpretation presents the material distinctly, with enough dating and surrounding context for readers to form their own view.
evidence_of_operation: Exhibits reproduced in full or with marked excisions; dates and surrounding messages included; interpretation clearly labelled.

name: Primary publication of own determinations
statement: The actor that issues official determinations or decisions bearing on the event (administrative sanctions, eligibility decisions, audit findings, formal assessments) publishes each one, in full or with marked redactions, dated and identified, at a stable location under its own control or in the official register designated for it, so that the public can find and cite the primary copy without relying on reproductions by third parties.
evidence_of_operation: A dated, identified primary copy on the issuer's own site or in the designated official register; stable URLs or record identifiers; marked redactions; a notice of any later modification, appeal or expiry linked from the original.
